title: 摩根士丹利王滢：内地市场调整到位了吗？估值或还有10-15%下行空间
speaker: Laura Wang

segments.en: Wang chief China equity strategies to walk us through a little bit more about where you see the bottom right now in this market? Yeah, absolutely. I mean, the China market hasn't done that well year to date. And if you look at how the correction has accelerated since August, almost the entirety year
segments.zh: 王首席中国权益策略师带我们进一步分析当前市场底部位置。好的。今年内地市场表现不佳，8月以来调整加速，几乎全年调整都发生在8月后。

segments.en: to date correction happened since August. So a lot of investors recently had come to us and asked whether we have already hit the bottom yet. And whether this is like the absolute trough we've ever seen.
segments.zh: 许多市场参与者近期询问是否已触底，以及这是否是绝对低点。

segments.en: Well, I mean, the short answer is no. If we look at what happened during the great financial crisis or what happened at the beginning of the COVID crisis, then valuations suggest that there could be
segments.zh: 简短回答是没有。参考全球金融变化或疫情初期情况，估值显示可能还有10%至15%下行空间。

segments.en: another 10 to 15 percent downside. That being said, we're not saying that the market absolutely has to drop that much before we can go up. We're also watching for other signs and we think values are
segments.zh: 但我们并非说市场必须跌那么多才能上涨。我们也在关注其他信号，认为某些行业和板块估值开始显现。

segments.en: starting to emerging in certain sectors and segments. Why do you think sediment has been so weak?
segments.zh: 你认为市场情绪为何如此疲弱？
